meaning:
σύνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּינָה and cogn. forms, מַשְׂכִּית, דַּעַת, חׇכְמָה, etc. ;]
1. a running or flowing together (Hom.).
2. (a) understanding: Luk.2:47, 1Co.1:19" (LXX), Eph.3:4, Col.1:9 2:2, 2Ti.2:7
(b) the understanding, the mind or intelligence: Mrk.12:33.†
SYN.: see: σοφία (AS)

elsewhere.note: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more…
All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,
For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in…
Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
